sections.description: A complete, white-label loyalty and referral program for WooCommerce. Customers earn points on every purchase, redeem them for dollar-value discounts at checkout, and invite friends via unique referral codes. Includes a floating rewards widget, in-cart / checkout banners, a My Account rewards tab, 5 transactional emails, HPOS-compatible order handling, admin analytics with Chart.js, CSV import/export, direct WPLoyalty migration, and a credit-on-signup queue for pending customer balances. Fully theme-agnostic — every store-visible element is override-safe against aggressive theme CSS.
sections.changelog:
1.7.1

A security release. Every store should update.

Security

  • Rewards coupons can no longer be stacked. Each customer has one current rewards coupon. Applying rewards again replaces it, a cart holds at most one, and its value is re-checked against the balance. An order that still carries two is put on hold with the coupons removed.
  • A failed payment no longer gives the points back for free. When a failed order is paid later (from My Account, say), the redeemed points are deducted again.
  • Two checkouts at once can't spend the same balance. Redemptions now lock the customer's balance while it's checked and debited.
  • Referral links can't be faked. The referral cookie is signed. Cookies set before this update are ignored, so those visitors need to use the link or code again.
  • First-order referral discounts are checked on the block checkout too. Typing a different email no longer makes a returning customer look new.
  • Referral and first-order rewards are taken back when the friend's order is refunded or cancelled. Friend discount coupons now expire after 7 days and can't be guessed.
  • Imported and guest balances need an email confirmation. A balance waiting for an email address (from an import, the WPLoyalty migration or a guest order) is credited only after the account clicks the "Collect my rewards" link sent to that address. The Rewards tab shows what's waiting, with a Resend button. Filter: wcle_pending_claim_requires_confirmation.
  • Updates are signed. Stores check each update's signature and checksum before installing it, and only accept downloads from the official releases page. Automatic updates stay on, and admins now see a notice saying so with a link to turn them off.
  • Webhooks: requests no longer follow redirects. Each webhook has a signing secret, and requests carry X-WCLE-Timestamp and X-WCLE-Signature headers. Saved auth headers are no longer shown in the admin.
  • Exports: cells that could run as spreadsheet formulas are neutralised.
  • Imports: a preview can only be processed once, point values are range-checked, and uploads over 20 MB are refused.
  • Admin:

- Only administrators can turn on "Remove all data on uninstall".

- Shop managers can't adjust or ban administrator accounts.

- Number settings and manual adjustments are range-checked.

Changed

  • The developer README is no longer included in the plugin zip; a short readme.txt replaces it.
  • Releases can be built and published from a Mac with bin/release-local.sh.

1.7.0

Added

  • Join the email list from the sign-up form. The account sign-up form (My Account and wp-login.php) can now show an unticked box: "Email me deals, restocks and new arrivals from {store}, and add {points} to my rewards after my first order. Unsubscribe anytime." Ticking it saves the consent with the new account (time, source loyalty-rewards-signup, IP, browser and the exact wording) and subscribes the customer in Omnisend a few seconds later, in the background, so a slow or unreachable email service never holds up sign-up (failed requests are retried up to three more times, an hour apart). The email list reward is paid once Omnisend shows them subscribed; under the completed-order rule, when their first order completes, and only after checking Omnisend again, so a customer who unsubscribed in between is neither paid nor put back on the list. Leaving the box unticked subscribes nobody. The Rewards tab shows "✓ On the list · added after your first order" while it's held. Settings → Ways to earn → Ask on the sign-up form (on by default, but it only shows where the email list reward has an amount and Omnisend for WooCommerce is connected, so stores that don't use the reward see no change)
  • wcle_email_optin_on_register and wcle_email_optin_text filters; WCLE_Email_Signup::optin_on_register(), optin_text(), has_optin()

Changed

  • WCLE_Omnisend::subscribe_email() and WCLE_Email_Signup::subscribe_and_check() take an optional consent record, used in place of the current request's details
  • Deactivating or uninstalling also clears the sign-up box's background jobs

1.6.1

Changed

  • Ways to earn is now the one place to set up earning, and the launcher shows exactly what it says. Each way to earn sits on one row: its switch, its amount (and the profile link for follow rewards), and a "Customers see" line saying what the launcher and the Rewards tab show, e.g. "Customers see: Sign up · 50 points". The line updates as you type, and warns when something is switched on but hidden ("On, but customers won't see it until you set an amount", "…until you add the profile link", "…until Omnisend for WooCommerce is connected"). "In the launcher now" at the top lists what customers currently see. Before, every switch read "Enabled" while features with no amount were silently missing from the launcher
  • The earn rate, the referrer reward, and every bonus amount and profile link moved onto the Ways to earn tab (same settings, so values are kept). The Bonuses tab is gone; the Earning and Referrals tabs keep their other settings
  • The launcher follows the settings everywhere, not just in its list. The welcome screen's tiles show ways to earn that are on (e.g. "Points on orders", "Sign-up bonus", then "Pay with points") instead of a fixed "Instant points / Pay with points / Refer & earn". The stock welcome pitch drops "every order" or the referral promise when those are off; a pitch the store wrote itself is left alone. The How it works card only says "every order" when orders earn, and gives the real expiry instead of always "Your points never expire". With referrals off, the signed-in "Friends joined" tile is hidden
  • My Account → Rewards: "More ways to earn" is now "Ways to earn", the same list as the launcher: orders, sign-up and first-order bonuses (✓ Earned once received), birthday (with an Add birthday link), reviews, the email list reward and follow rewards
  • In the launcher, the sign-up and first-order rows show ✓ Earned once a customer has received them

Added

  • [wcle_ways_to_earn] shortcode: the same list for any page (a Rewards page, a footer), so it never goes out of date. referrals="no" leaves referrals out
  • WCLE_Ways_To_Earn: get_rows(), status(), get_tiles(), default_pitch(), rate_card_text()
